profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building, deploying, and supporting production grade systems in enterprise environments. I specialize in backend development, release management, and collaborating across teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions.

In my work, I’ve contributed to backend services, supported CI/CD pipelines, and played an active role in deployment and release cycles. I take ownership beyond writing code partnering with developers, QA, and supporting teams, creating clear technical documentation, coordinating release meetings, and ensuring tasks are well-defined and delivered end to end.

I’m especially comfortable in fast paced, production critical environments where thoughtful decision making, risk awareness, and clear communication matter. I value maintainable code, transparent processes, and building systems that teams can trust and evolve over time.

I’m motivated by roles where engineering work directly impacts users and business outcomes, and I enjoy collaborating with teams that value ownership, continuous improvement, and strong engineering fundamentals.

📍 Charlotte, NC

💻 Interests: Backend Engineering, Platform Engineering, FinTech, Scalable Systems

🤝 Open to conversations about software engineering opportunities and impactful projects

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead Release Management Team to deploy production changes across LOANIQ department that consisted of 10 teams

Lead the process of setting up meetings and creating task lists to make sure production of changes were properly executed

Coordinated CRQ approvals with release management teams to support weekly data scrubs and production releases

Documented and executed changes under CRQ and maintained compliance with enterprise standards

Collaborated with L2 Team before all production releases, CRQ changes, and deployments to help with monitoring

Collaborated with L2 Team to troubleshoot post release incidents and ensure successful rollout

Worked with a team to manage source code and team collaboration via BitBucket, which included pull requests, code reviews, and issue tracking

Worked with a team to integrate GitHub Copilot into VS Code workflow to improve code consistency and development

Integrated GitHub Copilot with CRQ closure documentation to be sent out using automation once checklist was approved.

Assisted in helping with daily deployment triage with all feature teams in LOANIQ department for deployment

Implemented branching strategy (feature, release, hot fix) to reduce merge conflicts and improve release cadence

Integrated branch workflows into CI/CD pipelines, automating testing and deployment for production ready builds.

Managed technical builds using XLRs across multiple environments including INIT1-Test, INIT1-Dev, LT, PreProd and Prod

Troubleshot environment specific deployment issues and optimized Ansible playbooks for reliability and scalability

Monitored, configured, and maintained batch jobs through Autosys workflow

Deployed PAB builds through pipelines for CI/CD using Jenkins and Autosys for production releases

Integrated the use of automated testing into CI/CD process to help improve code reliability and developer efficiency

projects.title: iSee!
projects.description: An IOS Mobile Application that would allow users to take a photo of their eye and identify problems that might require professional help with their vision. This is accomplished with Machine Learning, Computer Vision, and SQL techniques.

organizations.name: Girls++
organizations.description: Keeping up the Girls++ social media outlets on different technology news and networking with guest speakers.

organizations.name: Digital Learners to Leaders
organizations.description: A digital literacy program, where five individual groups work on projects to help better the Atlanta community.
